summaries.en: In the Democratic Party's National Convention nationwide touring primaries, Choi Min-hee reclaimed the top spot for the Supreme Council, increasing the likelihood of 'Team Jung Cheong-rae' candidates securing a majority, though the final outcome may still change after delegate votes and public opinion polls.
summaries.zh: 在共同民主党全国代表大会巡回初选中，崔敏熙议员夺回最高委员第一名，提高了“郑清来团队”候选人获得最高委员会多数席位的可能性，但最终结果仍可能因代议员投票和国民舆论调查而改变。
